content.text: Still nothing from PackRight. I'll note the contingency on the plan and the calendar so it doesn't get lost:

values: Slot held for Marcus: 40 custom-label Balsam tins, $16 each + label cost, waiting on PackRight. If the labels fall through, offer Rae ~40 tins (Balsam/Cranberry) at $9 by Dec 8 in this slot (Tess, Nov 1). Cures Dec 5; last pour ready for Riverside Dec 6.

patch.description: Slot held for Marcus's wedding favors: 40 Balsam & Cedar tins with custom labels, $16/tin + label cost, pending PackRight. If the labels fall through, offer Rae ~40 tins (Balsam/Cranberry) at $9 by Dec 8 instead (Tess's call, Nov 1). Also: Fireside 8 jars; Cranberry 10/15/2; Vanilla 4 tins/3 jars; gift-set tins 20 each F/B/C. ~63 lb. Cures Dec 5.

content.text:
Okay, Marcus keeps the Nov 21 pour spot, and Rae gets offered tins only if his labels fall through.

PackRight still hasn't replied, so nothing has gone to Marcus or Rae yet. I've noted the plan in the Holiday 2026 sheet and on the Nov 21 pour, and put a reminder on your calendar for Tue Nov 3 to chase PackRight about the labels and the $136 supply order.

Here's what happens once they answer:
- **If the labels can be ready by about Dec 3:** I'll tell Marcus yes at $640 for the 40 tins ($16 each) plus the label cost, and add one more Balsam & Cedar oil to the Northwick order (about $17.50, within budget). His tins get poured Nov 21 and ship by Dec 7.
- **If they can't:** I'll tell Marcus kindly that we can't do custom labels in time. Then I'll offer Rae about 40 tins (Balsam & Cedar and Cranberry Orange) at $9, delivered by Dec 8, in that same Nov 21 spot. That's 40 rather than the 48 she asked for, because that's all that fits.

Everything else is set:
- **Supplies:** Northwick ($740.20) and Clearline ($486) are confirmed. Four Fireside bottles arrive around Nov 5, so Fireside goes into the Nov 7 pour.
- **Rae's jars:** 24 jars, confirmed for Dec 1.
- **Black Friday:** 15% off Balsam & Cedar, Cranberry Orange, Vanilla Bourbon, Sea Fog and Fig & Black Tea, Nov 27–30. Fireside, the winter trio and the wax melts aren't included.
- **Craftweb:** listings show only cured stock, with calendar reminders to add each batch once it has cured.

RESULT: NOT DONE. Marcus and Rae's tins depend on PackRight's answer about the labels; I'll chase them Nov 3.
